review_text: Loved their biscoff latte plus the ambiance is cozy ✨ i just wish they open til 2am 😄

Ordered Spanish Latte and Tapa with egg. I like the coffee. The tapa is also delicious. If you could just make the plate a little bigger, it would be a bit difficult to eat, but there are still so many tapas. Can you request high chairs? The chairs are too low to the table. Will visit again.
